headline: Wood Waste Becomes Climate Solution in Finnish Innovation
meta_description: Finnish startup Elementic turns lignin byproduct into MO6 tiles that lock away twice as much carbon as wood for thousands of years.
summary_short: A Finnish materials company has transformed wood mill waste into premium wall tiles that store carbon permanently, launching their first collection at Helsinki Design We…
body:
A Finnish startup called Elementic has found an elegant use for something the timber industry normally discards. Lignin, the fibrous component left over when wood is processed, has become the foundation for MO6—a wall-surfacing tile that stores roughly 2.4 kilograms of atmospheric carbon dioxide for every kilogram of material produced. That is double the carbon storage capacity of wood itself, and unlike timber, MO6 does not decay or release its carbon back into the atmosphere. According to Elementic, the carbon could remain locked within the material for potentially thousands of years.

The tiles, finished with an off-black color and dramatic rough texture, launched their debut collection, MO6 Eternal, on September 2 at Habitare, a design trade fair in Helsinki. Rather than marketing the product primarily on environmental grounds, Elementic positioned it as a premium interior design choice, deliberately targeting architects, hotel developers, and interior designers who might not otherwise seek sustainable building materials. A spa under construction in Paris became among the first named projects to receive the tiles. The company has focused its initial marketing on hotels and restaurants, with plans to expand into hotels and restaurants specifically.

What makes this story more than just another green material is the deliberate strategy behind it. By treating MO6 as a design product first and a climate solution second, Elementic reaches buyers who care about aesthetics alongside sustainability. The next phase of development promises even broader impact: the company plans to produce bricks, a shift that would move MO6 from interior finish to structural material, opening possibilities for carbon storage at building scale. Elementic's success suggests a quieter path forward for climate innovation—one where environmental benefit travels alongside beauty and function.

Launched September 2 at Helsinki Design Week's Habitare trade fair

Finnish startup Elementic transforms timber mill waste into premium tiles
